oai_dc:dc.dc:title: Pursuing Academic Librarianship: First Librarian Positions
oai_dc:dc.dc:creator: Iglesias, Aubrey
Gard, Charlotte
oai_dc:dc.dc:description: We administered a nationwide survey to help library and information science (LIS) students and recent graduates considering academic librarianship strategize their career preparation and job search endeavors based on recent graduates’ experiences. This article focuses on respondents’ first librarian positions by population groups represented in the survey and based on librarian position pathway. Statistically significant differences are most prevalent when comparing the respondents of with those not of Hispanic, Latino, or Spanish origin including in position status (part-time and residency positions), being an internal job candidate, and not having moved out of state for the first academic librarian position.
oai_dc:dc.dc:publisher: Association for Information Science and Technology
